@@ -36,1 +36,12 @@ - * + * Caches the calculated value of each styleable property a specific combination of + * pseudo-class states and font size (see {@link Key}). An entry is shared by every + * {@code Styleable} that has that same combination. + *

+ * {@link #get(String)} returning {@code null} means only that no one has evaluated that + * property for this entry yet; it should never be treated as "no style applies"(!). This + * because when an entry is absent, it could be because the property was bound, or the property + * didn't exist at the time of evaluation (because a Skin with that property wasn't attached yet + * or Skins were swapped). + *
